title: SeisGrad: sampling-aware gradient attributes for 3D seismic volumes
description: Revision reproducibility release accompanying the manuscript "Grid dependence of gradient-derived seismic attributes: a sampling-aware formulation". Version 1.1.2 reports both shared physical-reference and implementation-matched reference comparisons for the synthetic and Penobscot cross-grid tests, uses the smaller synthetic gain separately for each attribute and grid, and adds a clean control for the exact channel configuration used in the paired 10 dB experiment. It also includes complete cross-grid shape-RMSE tables, paired 30-realization Gaussian and colored/impulsive/footprint tests, velocity and finite-difference-order sensitivity, and a public Penobscot anti-aliased resampling experiment. The external Penobscot data are referenced by DOI and are not redistributed.
